name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 11, 2019 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation of Proclamation proclaiming December 14, 2019 as a day of Remembrance for all Victims of Gun Violence
4B.
Presentation by the Encinitas Lions Club
4C.
Presentation on the State of the Urban Forest
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the November 13, 2019 Special Meeting Closed Session, and the November 13, 2019 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2019-12-11 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Appointment to the Senior Citizen Commission to fill one unscheduled vacancy. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Mayor’s recommendation to appoint Linda Diller to the Senior Citizen Commission with a term ending March 2021 to fill one unscheduled vacancy created by the resignation of Gary Schneiderman.
2019-12-11 Item 08B Appointment to the Senior Citizen Commission - Redacted
8C.
Consideration of Proposed Changes to the Calendar Year 2020 City Council Meeting Schedule. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the proposed changes to the Calendar Year 2020 City Council Meeting Schedule and adopt City Council Resolution 2019-112 approving the 2020 meeting schedule.
2019-12-11 Item 08C Proposed Changes to the 2020 Meeting Schedule
8D.
Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinances No. 2019-24, No. 2019-25, and No. 2019-26 for amendments to Title 4, 14, 24, and 30 of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Local Coastal Plan to modify design requirements and development standards for Pedestrian and Bicycle Connectivity (Ordinance No. 2019-24), to limit the number of dogs allowed in residential districts or in conjunction with any residential use in any other district (Ordinance No. 2019-25), and to modify existing traffic code regulations (Ordinance 2019-26). Contact Person: Associate Planner Zornes
1) Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2019-24 titled “An Ordinance of The City of Encinitas Adopting Amendments to Title 24 (Subdivisions), Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code, and Local Coastal Plan, to Modify Design Requirements and Development Standards for Pedestrian and Bicycle Connectivity;” 2) Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2019-25 titled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Adopting Amendments to Title 4 (Animal Regulations) of the Encinitas Municipal Code, to Limit the Number of Dogs Allowed in all Residential Districts or in Conjunction with any Residential Uses in any other District;” and 3) Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2019-26 titled “An Ordinance of The City of Encinitas Adopting Amendments to Title 14 (Traffic Code) of The Encinitas Municipal Code, to Modify Existing Traffic Code Regulations.”
2019-12-11 Item 08D Priority Code Amendments 2nd Reading Ords. 2019-24,25, 26
8E.
Approval of plans, specifications and authorization to advertise the Standard Pacific Park Project (CP14A). Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
Approve the plans, specifications and cost estimate and authorize advertisement of the Standard Pacific Park Project (CP14A).
2019-12-11 Item 08E Approve Plans and Specs for Standard Pacific Park
2019-12-11 Item 08E Approve Plans and Specs for Standard Pacific Park Supplemental Agenda Report - Posted 12-10-2019
8F.
Amendment No. 2 to the Contract for Carpet Replacement at City of Encinitas Community Library and Public Works Facility Between the City of Encinitas and G&S Carpet Mills, Inc. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
Authorize the City Manager, or her Designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute Amendment No. 2 to the contract for carpet replacement at City of Encinitas Community Library and Public Works Facility between the City of Encinitas and G&S Carpet Mills, Inc., in substantial form, amending the contract for a total not to exceed amount of $228,871.
2019-12-11 Item 08F G&S Carpet Mills Amendment
8G.
Proposed Revisions to the First Tier Speed Cushion Program. Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Edgeworth
Approve the proposed revisions to the First Tier Speed Cushion Program.
2019-12-11 Item 08G First Tier Speed Cushion Program
8H.
Award B Street Sidewalks Construction Contract (CD05E). Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract in substantial form as attached, and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, to Portillo Concrete in the amount of $486,945 plus a 15 percent contingency of $73,042 for a total contract amount not to exceed $559,987 to construct the B Street Sidewalk Improvements Project (CD05E).
2019-12-11 Item 08H Award B Street Sidewalks Construction Contract
8I.
Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and Encinitas Friends of the Arts. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam
Authorize the City Manager to execute a Memorandum of Understanding with Encinitas Friends of the Arts, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form, as attached, to provide arts and culture programs for the community through December 31, 2021.
2019-12-11 Item 08I MOU with Encinitas Friends of the Arts
8J.
Consideration of an Exclusive Negotiating Agreement with Encinitas Arts, Culture and Ecology Alliance (EACEA) on the Pacific View Property. Contact Person: Parks and Recreation Director Campbell
Authorize the Mayor to execute the attached 90-day Exclusive Negotiating Agreement, in substantial form subject to the review and approval by the City Attorney, with the EACEA.
2019-12-11 Item 08J Exclusive Negotiating Agreement with EACEA
8K.
Second Reading and Adoption of Ordinance 2019-29 to Amend Municipal Code Chapter 23.40, Floodplain Management Regulations, to comply with Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) requirements. Contact Person: Principal Planner Bankston
Adopt Ordinance No. 2019-29, entitled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Municipal Code Chapter 23.40 – Floodplain Management Regulations.”
2019-12-11 Item 08K Floodplain Management Ordinance 2019-29 Adoption
8L.
Rancho Santa Fe Traffic Analysis. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
1) Approve the scope of work for the Rancho Santa Fe Road traffic analysis to enhance mobility, improve travel time and minimize delay along the corridor; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-104, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget” to allocate $50,000 to the General Mobility Improvements (CS18E) project.
2019-12-11 Item 08L Rancho Santa Fe Traffic Analysis
8M.
Approve the Plans, Specifications and Authorize Advertisement of the Trail 82 and Trail 95 (CP00F) Projects. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
Approve the plans, specifications and cost estimate, and authorize advertisement for Trail 82 and Trail 95 (CP00F).
2019-12-11 Item 08M Approve plans and specs to bid Trail 82 and 95
8N.
Shoreline Erosion Protection Grant from the State of California Department of Parks and Recreation, Division of Boating and Waterways (DBW), to support construction funds for the Coastal Storm Damage Reduction Project. Contact Person: Coastal Zone Program Administrator Timberlake
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-110 authorizing submittal of a joint application with the City of Solana Beach for a Shoreline Erosion Protection Grant to the State of California Department of Parks and Recreation, Division of Boating and Waterways; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to act on behalf of the City of Encinitas, in consultation with the City Attorney, to negotiate and execute all agreements and amendments necessary to comply with the Division of Boating and Waterways grant requirements.
2019-12-11 Item 08N Shoreline Erosion Protection Grant
8O.
Engineering services contract for the FY 2019-20 Street Resurfacing Project (CS20A). Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a three-year contract with two additional one-year extensions in substantial form (Attachment 1), and any necessary amendments and time extensions, with CJ Roberts Inc. for the FY 2019-20 Street Resurfacing Project (CS20A). Year One not-to-exceed amount is $152,700 plus ten percent contingency ($15,270) for a total of $167,970; Year Two not-to-exceed amount is $157,281 plus ten percent contingency ($15,728) for a total of $173,009; and Year Three not-to-exceed amount is $161,999 plus ten percent contingency ($16,200) for a total of $178,199. The total not-to-exceed amount over the three-year contract would be $471,980 plus contingency of $47,198 for a total of $519,178.
2019-12-11 Item 08O Annual Street Resurfacing
8P.
Amendment to the Street Sweeping Services Agreement with Cannon Pacific Sweeping, Inc. (Cannon). Contact Person: Superintendent Ugrob
Authorize the City Manager to amend the agreement with Cannon for the addition of specialized bike lane sweeping services in the amount of $10,080 per year, for the final year of the agreement, for a contract total amount not to exceed $1,554,040.
2019-12-11 Item 08P Pacific Cannon Amendment 2
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Presentation of the City's Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2019. Contact Person: Finance Manager Huang
Accept and file the Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2019.
2019-12-11 Item 10A Comprehensive Annual Financial Report
10B.
Introduction of Draft Ordinance No. 2019-28 for amendments to the Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan (DESP) and the Local Coastal Plan to make changes to the planning palette, location, and planting guidelines within Chapters 4 and 7 of the DESP. Contact Person: Associate Planner Plagemann
1) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2019-28 titled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting Amendments to The Downtown Encinitas Specific Plan to Address Changes to the Street Tree Guidelines.”
2019-12-11 Item 10B Amendments to the DESP - Street Tree Guidelines
10C.
Report on Red Light Photo Enforcement. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Receive report on Red Light Photo Enforcement (RLPE) operation and direct staff to return before April 2020 to extend the contract.
2019-12-11 Item 10C Red Light Camera Report
10D.
Discussion and possible appointments of Encinitas City Council Members to Regional Boards and Committees, and consideration and possible action regarding existing Ad-Hoc Subcommittee appointments. Contact Person: Executive Assistant to the Mayor and City Council Clisby
1) Discuss the Mayor’s recommended appointments to City and regional committees and boards for 2020; 2) Approve the final appointments to City and regional committees and boards for 2020; and 3) Consider and possibly take action regarding Council ad-hoc subcommittee appointments, as desired.
2019-12-11 Item 10D Regional Committee and Board Appointments
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON DECEMBER 18, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
